name: Narrative Monthly Report Builder
description: Automatically gathers metrics from GA4, Facebook Ads, Google Ads, and Search Console, generates AI-written narrative commentary via OpenAI GPT-4o, and produces a polished Google Slides or PDF monthly report delivered to the client via email and Slack.
features: Multi-source data ingestion (GA4, Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Search Console)
AI-powered narrative report writing with OpenAI GPT-4o
Email delivery via Gmail with report preview
Google Sheets logging for audit trail
Modular architecture — add/remove data sources easily
